synopsis.title: QVX-101 versus shared control in Disease X
synopsis.rationale: QVX-101 is a synthetic vesicle transport regulator intended to preserve function in Disease X. The proposed comparison will test whether this mechanism translates into an arm-specific clinical effect. The discovery program used a fictional vesicle-retention assay; because two laboratory series gave different magnitudes of response, the sponsor selected a conservative fixed exposure rather than treating the assay as a direct measure of clinical benefit. The program has no prior human exposure to QVX-101, and QVX-101 is not approved in any indication.
